reviews.author: Ines Vardan
reviews.headline: Paisley without the costume
reviews.body: I was nervous about a full paisley print, but the scale is small enough that it reads as texture from across a room. It has become the dress I pack when I only have room for one.

reviews.author: Marguerite Sowa
reviews.headline: Travels without creasing
reviews.body: Rolled in a suitcase for nine days and hung out overnight. No steaming, no marks. The crimson has not faded after three washes on a cold delicate cycle.
